notes.title: Gun Dealer Simulator: Quick Tips
notes.content:
[h3][b]Welcome to the Trade. Gun Dealer Simulator  - v0.0.3r is available now.[/b][/h3][p]Before you dive into the risky business of arms dealing—whether you choose to stay on the legal side or take your chances on the black market—here’s a list of quick, spoiler-free tips to help you build your operation, earn a reputation, and survive in a world where every deal counts.[/p][p][/p][h3]Learn to Use Your Phone[/h3][p]Press [b]C[/b] to open your in-game phone — it’s your main control center for:[/p][list][*][p]Managing black market deals (especially at night)[/p][/*][*][p]Always keep empty boxes on hand to fulfill delivery deals that appear during the night[/p][/*][*][p]Skipping time to the next day when you have nothing left to do[/p][/*][/list][p]The phone is essential. Many systems in the game won’t function unless you interact through it.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692044/9f5dbfd2838ea2462b9dce65090df9ae8e98393f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Use the Map and Radar to Navigate[/h3][p]Press [b]Tab[/b] or [b]M[/b] to open the map and waypoint system. These will help you:[/p][list][*][p]Track seller locations scattered across the map[/p][/*][*][p]Set destination points[/p][/*][*][p]Navigate more efficiently, especially when using your vehicle[/p][/*][/list][p]Without waypoints, it’s easy to waste time wandering or missing key vendors.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692044/9a88946ea01048fb32c760f0fd2f1a5f5a559a96.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Secure a Store and Buy a Warehouse[/h3][p]Early in the game, you’ll need to [b]rent your store[/b] to begin official operations. After that, invest in a [b]local warehouse[/b] to:[/p][list][*][p]Store large amounts of weapons or equipment[/p][/*][*][p]Avoid clutter and better manage your inventory flow
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692044/a26d46a511c597a97be555145e4186a8ea418fe8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Manage Electricity or Lose Everything[/h3][p]Your store depends on power. If the [b]electricity is off[/b], your:[/p][list][*][p]Doors won’t open[/p][/*][*][p]Lights won’t turn on[/p][/*][*][p]Computers and vending machines won’t function[/p][/*][/list][p]Always check your power if something stops working unexpectedly.[/p][p]                   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692044/522d3ad34def65d6313c0458112660696a78cc66.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Keep Your Store Clean[/h3][p]Trash reduce your [b]store reputation[/b], which directly affects customer behavior. Use a [b]trash bucket[/b] to:[/p][list][*][p]Collect multiple pieces of garbage at once[/p][/*][*][p]Recycle them quickly[/p][/*][*][p]Keep the store attractive to new clients[/p][/*][/list][p]A clean store is a trusted store.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692044/d760ed32150d5ddae543e289b6d732862b52b53b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Use Your Car, But Don’t Forget Gas[/h3][p]You’ll eventually gain access to a [b]vehicle[/b], which helps speed up travel across the map. However:[/p][list][*][p]The car [b]requires fuel[/b] — no gas, no movement[/p][/*][*][p]Refueling regularly will save you time and frustration[/p][/*][*][p]Many vendors are spread out, so the car is a major quality-of-life upgrade[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692044/f06db7d0f9cea359d0efbc408f8d9ee00f246764.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Watch for Nighttime Deals[/h3][p]Black market arms deals are more common at night, often with higher risk and reward. Be prepared:[/p][list][*][p]Keep extra empty boxes on hand to package items quickly[/p][/*][*][p]Manage your [b]store heat[/b] and [b]reputation[/b], as illegal deals can draw unwanted attention[/p][/*][*][p]Use the phone to view or skip nighttime activity[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692044/b151b676a5d79a5bbcdedecf6adea340241709d9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Not Every Customer is Safe[/h3][p]Some customers will:[/p][list][*][p]Use [b]fake licenses[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Attempt to steal[/b] from your store[/p][/*][/list][p]Always verify documentation. Stay alert. And consider installing upgrades or safety measures when available.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692044/792485cf6e4a2d7d95b0b702964e3fc9106e2007.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Reputation Matters[/h3][p]Your [b]store reputation[/b] affects everything:[/p][list][*][p]A low reputation means customers will avoid your shop[/p][/*][*][p]A high reputation brings better clients and more business[/p][/*][*][p]Cleanliness, deal success, and customer treatment all contribute to reputation[/p][/*][/list][p]If no one’s entering your store, check your reputation score.[/p][p][/p][p]                   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692044/522d3ad34def65d6313c0458112660696a78cc66.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Handle Your Finances Wisely[/h3][p]Money management is critical. You can:[/p][list][*][p]Take out [b]loans[/b] to stay afloat during rough patches[/p][/*][*][p]Pay [b]weekly bills[/b] on time via [b]ATM[/b] machines (or face penalties)[/p][/*][*][p]Gamble your profits at the [b]casino[/b] — but be warned, luck can turn fast[/p][/*][/list][p]Overspending or ignoring bills will quickly lead to failure.[/p][p][/p][h3]Licenses Unlock Progression[/h3][p]Without proper licenses, you can’t:[/p][list][*][p]Purchase new items[/p][/*][*][p]Expand your store[/p][/*][*][p]Access key features in the economy[/p][/*][/list][p]Visit the [b]Omni Permit [/b]at shop PC and prioritize unlocking essential features early. A locked-down dealer is a broke dealer.

[/p][h3]Final Advice[/h3][p]Gun Dealer Simulator is about [b]strategy, risk management[/b], and [b]operational control[/b]. It’s not just about selling — it’s about how, when, and to whom you sell.[/p][list][*][p]Use your tools[/p][/*][*][p]Understand each system[/p][/*][*][p]Don’t rush expansion[/p][/*][*][p]And always keep an eye on your reputation and balance sheet[/p][/*][/list][p]Master these basics, and you’ll avoid early frustration — and possibly discover just how far your empire can grow.[/p]
